V-M-TUI-RECORDS.TraceAssertion: The declared go vet command type-checks the listed packages and checks static diagnostics. No automated behavioral test coverage is declared; scenarios require manual verification.
V-M-TUI-RECORDS.Scenario: Manual check: Open help from each panel and return with any key without triggering that key's records action; preserve selection, page, scroll position, and existing errors across resizing.
Manual check: Help actions and mouse events do not mutate records or access persistence; dialog insert mode retains ? and q as text.
Manual check: Compact and wide snapshots preserve terminal modes and dialog cursors while showing help/load/save/quit hints in the inactive-color footer.
Manual check: On either active panel, gg selects the first row and G selects the last row; ge and gs continue to change panel focus.

Manual check: Questionnaire transitions retain alternate-screen mode and records selections, pagination, scroll position, and errors; cancelling or completing skipped setup does not trigger records actions.

Manual check: s/l start asynchronous save/load only from records. Transfers prevent overlap and unsafe edits; successful restore refreshes units/data while retaining selected IDs and terminal dimensions.

V-M-TUI-HELP.TraceAssertion: The declared go vet command type-checks the listed packages and checks static diagnostics. No automated behavioral test coverage is declared; scenarios require manual verification.
V-M-TUI-HELP.Scenario: Manual check: Render titled, tab-aligned groups without a separate page title using one-row vertical and two-column horizontal padding; use active-panel color for keys and inactive-border color for borderless records hints.
Manual check: Place groups side by side when space allows, stack on compact widths, and reach all content by scrolling.
Manual check: Render home/gg, end/G, r reset setup, l load, and s save in help; l is absent from next-page bindings and separate Preferences/Sync destinations remain removed.

V-M-TUI-STARTER.TraceAssertion: The declared go vet command type-checks the listed packages and checks static diagnostics. No automated behavioral test coverage is declared; scenarios require manual verification.
V-M-TUI-STARTER.Scenario: Manual check: Ctrl+C and Ctrl+Z emit quit in records and dialogs; every key delegates from help and returns to records.
Manual check: Exercise records, help, open-dialog, and questionnaire states with the actual model and a temporary SQLite database; q remains text in dialogs and setup.

V-M-TUI-QUESTIONNAIRE.TraceAssertion: The declared go vet command type-checks the listed packages and checks static diagnostics. No automated behavioral test coverage is declared; scenarios require manual verification.
V-M-TUI-QUESTIONNAIRE.Scenario: Manual check: A missing preferences row opens unit setup, then provider setup; skipped answers and cancelled setup leave application tables untouched. An explicitly saved preference suppresses later automatic setup.

Manual check: r reopens setup while retaining records selection, pages, offsets, errors, and existing settings. Dialog and help input retain ownership; p no longer opens a screen and s remains a records-only save action.

Manual check: Unit/provider/code steps fill the usable terminal with main-view spacing and a complete border; compact/tiny/zero layouts remain bounded. Native input cursor stays in bounds and code input is masked.

Manual check: Async authorization and saves support invalid input, failure retry, cancellation, and stale-message rejection; successful completion updates visible weights. ctrl+r retries with a fresh session; ctrl+o exposes the complete scrollable URL at compact sizes.
